Our services

Termites & pests — handled

Whether you have birds roosting in your attic, bugs nesting in your walls, mice making homes in your kitchen cabinets, or spiders stringing webs across your eaves — we can help eliminate them.

Termite Control

One of the most frequent grievances of homeowners is a termite infestation. Southern California is home to two species that invade buildings: drywood and subterranean termites.

Spiders & Webs

Spiders stringing webs across your eaves, bugs nesting in your walls — we eliminate them, inside and out.

Ants

Ant trails in the kitchen, nests in the walls — targeted treatment that stops the colony at its source.

Cockroaches & Bugs

Effective extermination for the pesky critters that infest homes and businesses — bugs in the walls, cabinets and eaves.

Mice & Rodents

Mice making homes in your kitchen cabinets, birds roosting in your attic — we find them and get them out.

Crawling Pests

Centipedes, millipedes and other crawling insects around the home — identified and treated by experienced technicians.

Our vision

Why homeowners choose DeBolt

Our goal is to deliver the finest pest management services to our customers, while ensuring exceptional quality and customer satisfaction at every step. We aspire to be the leading pest management company in Southern California.

The likelihood of termite damage to a residence is ten times higher than that of fire. Approximately one out of every thirty homes experiences termite damage, resulting in over 5 billion dollars in property damage each year, as reported by Pest World.
